cards.card_text: Ungodliness spread from them through the land They moved their altars out to Samaria They stopped teaching the priests the law
cards.verse_text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says concerning the prophets: “I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”
cards.snippet: …give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”

cards.card_text: But Timothy has to avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which Paul says will only lead to more ungodliness.
